common.fixtureBanner: This screen is built from example data, not collected data. Do not rely on it.

home.title: Who are you travelling with?
home.intro: What you choose here changes the verdicts on the screens that follow. Choosing nothing is fine.
howTo: Pick the conditions of the people travelling with you. Several at once is fine.
In the place list, read the verdict and what still needs checking.
On a detail page, expand “How this score was calculated” to see the whole basis of the verdict.
home.cognitiveOption: Travelling with a child who finds new places hard
home.cognitiveHint: You can choose this only when you are travelling with a stroller.
home.minRuleTitle: The verdict follows whoever needs the most support
home.minRule: If you choose more than one condition, the calculation follows the one this place serves worst. That keeps an item that is decisive for one person from being hidden behind another person’s score.
home.statItems: Items we check at each place
home.statNote: A blank field means “not known yet”, never “not available”. This service keeps those two apart everywhere.

places.title: Baekje sites and related places in Gongju and Buyeo
places.sortNote: Ordered by verdict: you can visit, check first, not enough information, consider another place. “Not enough information” sits above “Consider another place” because not knowing about a place is better news than knowing you cannot enter it. Places with the same verdict are ordered by how much of what your conditions rest on has been checked.
places.noVerdict: {unknown} of the {total} items this verdict rests on have not been checked.
places.resultsReady: Calculated the verdict for {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}.
places.unknownCount: {count, plural, one {# not checked} other {# not checked}}

place.scoreHiddenReason: Not enough information to judge — check on site
place.openCalc: See how this verdict was worked out
place.roundingNote: Displayed values are rounded to three decimals. The score is computed before rounding, so the sum of the rows and the A total can differ in the last digit.
place.freshnessNote: An old check date means we are less sure, not that the place is worse — so it does not reduce the score.
place.whyCautionUnknown: Required items we do not know: {items}
place.whyCautionCoverage: Only {known} of the {total} items the verdict needs are known
place.axisAllUnknown: Nothing is known about {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} on the {axis} axis
place.etcNotesHint: Source text we could not split into individual accessibility items. It does not enter the score.
place.reportsDisclaimer: Visitors write these, and the operator has not checked them. They are separate from the items above and do not enter the verdict.
place.alternativesHint: Places with a better verdict under the same conditions.
place.safetyNote: The distances below are straight lines between two points, not the distance you would walk — on a hill fortress the path is far longer. A facility whose coordinates we could not confirm carries no distance. None of this enters the verdict: what counts as close enough is not something this material can settle.
place.crowdNote: A forecast for the next 30 days, not how busy it is right now. It is not a score out of 100 and its unit is not published, so it only means something against the same place on another date.
place.noPhotos: No photographs have been collected for this place yet.
place.reportsReady: Loaded {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}}.
place.reportsFailed: Reports could not be loaded. That does not mean there are none — it means we cannot check right now.
place.reportFlagFailed: Could not flag this report. Try again in a moment.
place.coverageBasis: items your conditions rest on whose status is known
place.perPersonaIntro: The verdict above follows whichever condition this place suits least. Taken one condition at a time:
place.perPersonaBasisKnown: {known} of {total} items this needs are checked
place.perPersonaBasisNone: The items this condition rests on do not apply at this place.
place.scoreInCalcNote: Computed from the checked items only. Unchecked items are left out, and which items are checked differs from place to place, so this is not a number to compare places by.
place.confidenceBasis: data confidence — coverage and check dates together
place.whyCautionScore: Everything this verdict rests on is checked, but the fit score is {score}, below the 75 needed for “You can visit”.
place.whyCautionPartial: These required items come with a condition: {items}

courses.multiplierNote: Stay times are multiplied by {multiplier, number} for {persona}
courses.restWarning: This leg is {minutes} minutes. The recommended limit for {persona} is {limit} minutes. Plan a break.
courses.empty: No course for this time budget yet.
courses.calculating: Building the course for your conditions.

routeGuide.naverNote: NAVER Map takes a start and an end only. The points in between are in the step list above.
routeGuide.none: No route guide was written for this place.
routeGuide.noneHint: Route guides are written by hand, one place at a time. They are never generated.

report.title: Report a condition
report.publicNotice: What you write here publishes at once and is visible to other visitors.
report.noLocationNotice: This screen does not collect location data.
report.detailHint: Do not write anything that identifies another person by name, contact detail or face.
report.consent: I agree that this is published immediately.

error.consent: You have to agree to immediate publication to post.
error.place: Choose which place this is about.
error.tooLong: Details can be up to 500 characters. This is {count}.
error.duplicate: You can post the same report only once a day.
error.unavailable: Reporting is not available right now: this site has no database connected to store reports.
error.failed: Could not post the report. Please try again in a moment.

report.done: Your report is posted. You can see it on the place page.
afterwards: It publishes at once. Nobody reads it first.
It appears only in the visitor-reports block on the place page, never mixed in with the items the verdict was taken from.
It does not enter the verdict. A report is what a visitor saw, not a fact we checked.
Anyone can flag a post, and a hidden one is actually deleted after 90 days.

gapReport.metaTitle: Barrier-free information gap report, Gongju and Buyeo
gapReport.title: Barrier-free information gap report, Gongju and Buyeo
gapReport.asOf: As of {date} · {places} places · KTO barrier-free travel items
gapReport.fillCaption: The three columns add up to that place’s item count.
gapReport.fillNote: The two columns stay apart because merging them would make the municipality look as though it had improved something every time we fill a cell ourselves. Only the “Confirmed by KTO” column going up means the municipality itself has moved.
gapReport.notRegistered: {place} — the place itself is not registered. It has to be registered before any item can be filled in.
gapReport.itemsIntro: Nobody has established the status of the items below from the material we hold. Whether the facility is absent or only the record is, and why, is not something we found out.
gapReport.itemsCaption: KTO barrier-free items whose status nobody has established yet.
gapReport.itemsGroupCritical: Items some condition takes its verdict on
gapReport.itemsGroupOther: Items no verdict rests on, still used on a visit
gapReport.blockedIntro: The items below are confirmed unavailable. Unlike an unknown, establishing the fact does not finish the job — it opens the question of an alternative or a change to the facility. What either would take is not something we established.
gapReport.visitorsDelay: The source data arrives about a month late, so the most recent weeks have no figure yet.
gapReport.visitorsUnavailable: The visitor trend has not been collected yet.
gapReport.empty: Nothing to list as an improvement priority.
